steps.what: George Lasry (with ChatGPT Astra 6 and Anthropic Opus 5.5) transcribed and deciphered the item: 1/8 pages transcribed; 7 more in part; 5/7 cipher pages deciphered; 2 more in part; 87 elements, 78 identified (89.7%). Report section: see report.

Spot-check against the Gallica image (https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/btv1b9064322t (volume link only; folio not fetched, checked on his crops of f759v and f761r)): Clear letter with name signs only. In his f759v crop: "je verray [3]" and "revolte en [X]", "[E] favorisera"; the f761r key ("Copia d una cifra trovata...") gives 3 = Mons. d Entragues, X = l Angleterre, E (variant) = l Escosse = his reading Verdict: partly confirmed.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): decryption = lasry_entry.md (excerpts and translation from George Lasry's BnF cipher research report); his full transcription and decryption are not in the repository (needs contributor: George Lasry).
